content:
dana: kicking off canary 5% for v3.5.0 → rolling to EU/edge.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started (id=rb-1795), 5% traffic, target=service-inference.
kevin: seeing the heatmap — initial latencies normal, but... release-notes not published yet, right?
release-notes: sorry, got caught up. the notes are still in draft, will push in ~10m. need the formal changelog + docs link.
maria: we should hold the rollout until notes are live. legal asked for the changelog before broader traffic.
jen: agreed. we can pause traffic shift now. @deploy-bot pause canary? use safe-drain.
deploy-bot: pause command received. Draining new variant connections and stopping further traffic shift.
oncall-bot: metric alert suppressed during manual hold. remember to unmute after resume.
kevin: confirm rollback plan in case we need to revert while held. dana, can you pin v3.4.1 routing in eu-edge? we may reroute if we see regressions.
dana: pinned v3.4.1 for region eu-edge via routing override (pin id=pin-892). applying now.
maria: ops note: if we rollback, prefer quick-fallback to v3.4.1 with `deploybot release rollback --id rb-1795 --to v3.4.1` and notify #support.
jen: release-notes, ping us when docs published. once notes are up we'll run a short QA validation against the canary samples and decide stop/go.
release-notes: pushed changelog and docs at https://docs/internal/redwood/v3.5.0/changelog — added security blurb and migration steps.
kevin: reading — LGTM. no breaking hops flagged. QA: @maria can you run the smoke prompts list?
maria: running smoke now, will paste failures. 3 quick checks ok, one formatting tweak in reranker output — low severity.
dana: OK let's resume gradual shift to 10% and monitor for 15m. deploy-bot, resume with step=10.
deploy-bot: resuming canary, target traffic=10% (rb-1795). will report progress every 2m.
jen: leaving hold open until 15m observation window closes and no regressions. if anything odd — call rollback.
oncall-bot: 15m window started — deadline 1795555299 (monitoring window).
kevin: copy. tagging this thread for postmortem notes if we had to pin/rollback.
dana: thanks everyone. holding until monitoring window completes. :thumbsup:
